create_TextDrawer: create a TextDrawer instance with framebuffer size, font path, and display font size for on-screen text rendering
add_text_with_alignment: add text to the screen using TextDrawer.add_text with a TextOnScreenAlignment enum value like TOP_LEFT or CENTER
draw_text_on_screen: draw all queued text on screen by calling TextDrawer.draw_text which renders text with Magnum GPU shaders
use_HeadlessTextDrawer: use HeadlessTextDrawer as a stub that forwards text to ClientMessageManager without GPU rendering for headless mode
configure_TextOnScreenAlignment: configure text position on screen using TextOnScreenAlignment enum values like TOP_RIGHT or BOTTOM_CENTER with pixel deltas
